# DevExpress.Win.Grid NuGet Package

Contains classes related to [DevExpress WinForms Data Grid](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/grid/), a data editing and shaping component with features that help you manage and display information based on business requirements.

## Key Features

* Performance: optimized data loading for large datasets, high-speed data sorting, grouping, and filtering, responsive UI through server-side data processing, infinite scrolling, asynchronous image loading, and real-time data updates.

* Flexible view-based architecture: standard table/grid view, banded column views, tile view, Kanban board, card view, Windows Explorer view.

* UI customization features: auto row height and cell merging, cell and row selection, customizable previews, unbound columns, pinned bands and columns, scrollbar annotations, column customization (move, show, hide, and resize), comprehensive custom draw API, and layout save and restore options.

* Support for major data source types.

* Data shaping and analysis options: high-speed multi-column sorting and grouping, merged column grouping, Outlook-inspired grouping, inline/partial grouping, master-detail grouping, summaries, and data aggregates.

* Search and data filtering: instant search and incremental search, query builder and filter criteria editor, Excel-inspired filtering, Auto Filter Row and custom filter UI, Filter Panel and most recently used (MRU) filters, group filters, comprehensive filtering API, and custom filters.

* Master-detail layouts with any number of nesting levels and details at each level.

* Data editing features: New Item Row for adding records, inline data editing, Edit Form for editing data in a separate form, custom edit forms, edit masks, HTML formatting, input validation, and error indication.

* Excel-inspired conditional formatting.

* Export to PDF, XLS, XLSX, MHT, CSV, HTML, RTF, DOCX, TXT, or an image file.
